units.title: Internet of Things (IoT) Introduction
units.topics: Introduction of IoT: Definition and characteristics of IoT, Technical Building blocks of IoT, Device, Communication Technologies, Data, Physical design of IoT, IoT enabling technologies, IoT Issues and Challenges- Planning, Costs and Quality, Security and Privacy, Risks.

units.title: Communication Protocols in IoT
units.topics: IoT Protocols: MQTT, CoAP, XMPP and AMQT, IoT communication models, IoT Communication technologies: Bluetooth, BLE, Zigbee, Zwave, NFC, RFID, LiFi, Wi-Fi, Interfacing of wifi, RFID, Zigbee, NFC with development board.

units.title: Interface sensors & actuators with Raspberry Pi for IoT applications
units.topics: Roles of sensors & actuators, types and working of sensors, Overview of Raspberry Pi, its models, features, pin description, board setup, and basic configuration, selection criteria, and sensor interfacing for IoT applications.

units.title: Programming and IoT Applications with Raspberry Pi
units.topics: Linux & Raspbian OS, basic Linux commands, Python programming, sensor interfacing (DHT11, PIR, Ultrasonic), IoT applications – web server, home automation, cloud connectivity, Node-RED basics.

units.title: IoT Applications
units.topics: IoT Applications Case studies are- Smart Home: Characteristics of Smart Home - Smart Home Energy Management, Smart Appliances, Communication Technologies for Smart Homes, maintenance, security, challenges. Smart Agricultural: characteristics and applications -Scarecrow, Smart Irrigation System, Crop Water Management, Integrated Pest Management, Sensor-based field and resource mapping, Remote equipment monitoring) E-health: Characteristics of e-health and applications- monitoring of health parameters, smart medicine box, elderly people monitoring, challenges

units.title: Fundamentals of Embedded Physical Design in IoT
units.topics: Basics of embedded physical design; role of physical design in IoT devices; design constraints – power, size, cost, performance; physical design flow for embedded IoT hardware; case study of IoT edge node physical design challenges.

units.title: Physical Layer Design: Sensors, Actuators & Interfaces
units.topics: Physical integration of sensors and actuators; packaging and interconnect technologies; signal integrity issues; hardware interfaces – I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, GPIOs from physical design perspective; clock distribution, synchronization, and noise management.

units.title: PCB and System-on-Chip Design for IOT
units.topics: PCB design principles for IoT devices – single and multi-layer boards; routing techniques for RF and low-power IoT modules; SoC design for IoT – low-power architectures, memory integration; power optimization, leakage reduction, and thermal management in embedded hardware.

units.title: Embedded Physical Design for Communication & Networking
units.topics: Physical design aspects of wireless IoT protocols – BLE, ZigBee, LoRa, NB-IoT, Wi-Fi; antenna design for compact IoT devices; power-aware RF transceiver design; EMI/EMC considerations; layout and shielding techniques for reliable IoT communication.

units.title: Applications & Case Studies
units.topics: Industrial IoT: rugged and reliable hardware design; healthcare IoT: low-power, miniaturization, and biocompatibility challenges; wearable IoT devices: flexible electronics and packaging; energy harvesting-based IoT hardware; case study – end-to-end physical design of a smart sensor node.

subjects.title: Computational and Optimization Methods for IoT Systems

units.title: Mathematical Foundations for IoT
units.topics: Linear Algebra: Concepts such as matrix operations, determinants, and eigenvectors. Emphasis on Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for data reduction and feature extraction from vast amounts of sensor data. Probability and Statistics: Advanced topics including stochastic processes, queuing theory, and Bayesian inference. Numerical Methods: Numerical solution of differential equations, interpolation, and regression analysis, focusing on their use for sensor calibration and data reconstruction.

units.title: Classical and Deterministic Optimization
units.topics: Unconstrained Optimization: In-depth study of gradient descent, Newton's method, and conjugate gradient algorithms for finding local minima in cost functions. Constrained Optimization: Introduction to Lagrange multipliers and the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions for solving optimization problems with equality and inequality constraints. Linear Programming: The Simplex method and duality theory. Applications will include optimizing network flow, assigning tasks to devices, and managing energy budgets. Dynamic Programming: The principle of optimality and its application to solving sequential decision-making problems, such as optimal routing and task scheduling in IoT networks.

units.title: Optimization in Distributed and Networked Systems
units.topics: Network Optimization: Algorithms for energy-efficient routing (e.g., Dijkstra's variant for energy cost), load balancing, and Quality of Service (QoS) in wireless sensor networks and Low-Power Wide-Area Networks (LPWANs). Edge and Fog Computing: Optimization models for task offloading and resource allocation between edge devices and cloud servers to minimize latency and bandwidth consumption. Data Aggregation and Fusion.

units.title: Computational Intelligence and Heuristic Methods
units.topics: Metaheuristic Algorithms: A study of Genetic Algorithms (GAs), Simulated Annealing, and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). These are used for problems where an optimal solution is computationally intractable, such as sensor placement or complex routing. Machine Learning and Optimization: The role of optimization in training machine learning models for IoT applications like anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, and pattern recognition. Reinforcement Learning: An introduction to RL frameworks for autonomous decision-making in a dynamic IoT environment, such as a self-configuring smart home or an autonomous vehicle.

units.title: Security, Privacy, and Practical Implementation
units.topics: Security & Privacy Optimization: Optimizing cryptographic key distribution, designing secure routing protocols, and using optimization to identify and mitigate cyber threats in real-time. Simulation and Emulation: Hands-on labs using tools like NS-3 or GNS3 for network simulation and Tensor Flow Lite for implementing machine learning models on resource-constrained devices like Raspberry Pi or ESP32. Case Studies: A project-based component where students apply the concepts to a real-world problem. Examples include optimizing an agricultural sensor network, designing a smart grid energy management system, or creating a healthcare monitoring system with a focus on data privacy.

units.title: Design with HDL
units.topics: Basics of Verilog: Typical HDL-flow, why Verilog HDL, trends in HDLs. Gate-Level Modelling: Modelling using basic Verilog gate primitives, description of and/or and buffer/not type gates, rise, fall and turn-off delays, min, max, and typical delays. Behavioral Modelling: Structured procedures, initial and always, blocking and non-blocking statements, delay control, generate statement, event control, conditional statements, Multiway branching, loops, sequential and parallel blocks.

units.title: ASIC Design Part I
units.topics: Types of ASIC and Comparisons, ASIC Design Flow, Logic Synthesis, Simulation, EDA Tools, ASIC Physical Design: Architecture Design, Physical Design, CAD Tools, System partitioning, Partitioning Strategies, Floor planning, Placement, Routing.

units.title: ASIC Design Part II
units.topics: ASIC Timing Analysis: Static timing analysis, Timing constraints, Delay estimation, ASIC Verification and Testing: Different Chip Test Methods, Fault Models, Scan Test, Partial Test, Digital scan standards, BIST architecture, BILBO, Boundary Scan, Self-Test, JTAG, ATPG

units.title: Chip Design
units.topics: Crystal Growth and Wafer Preparation: Introduction, Electronic-Grade Silicon, Czekalski Crystal Growing. Epitaxy: Introduction, Vapor-Phase Epitaxy. Lithography: Introduction, Optical Lithography, Electron Lithography, X-ray Lithography, Ion Lithography. Reactive Plasma, Etching: Introduction, Plasma Properties, Feature-Size Control and Anisotropic Etch Mechanisms, Reactive Plasma-Etching Techniques and Equipment.

units.title: Chip Fabrication
units.topics: Ion Implantation: Introduction, Range Theory, Implantation Equipment, Annealing, Shallow Junctions, High-Energy Implantation. Metallization: Introduction, Metallization Applications, Metallization Choices, Physical Vapor Deposition, Patterning, Metallization problems.

units.title: IoT Architecture, Ecosystem, and Security Basics
units.topics: IoT device characteristics, resource constraints in IoT, heterogeneity and interoperability issues, introduction to IoT security, privacy concerns in IoT, overview of security challenges and solutions.

units.title: Threat Models, Vulnerabilities and Attacks in IoT
units.topics: IoT threat surfaces, attack vectors in IoT devices and networks, sensor-level attacks, RFID vulnerabilities, routing and denial-of-service attacks, firmware and hardware exploitation, physical security threats, side-channel attacks, privacy breaches, attack modeling and classification frameworks.

units.title: Cryptography, Authentication, and Access Control
units.topics: Lightweight cryptography for IoT, symmetric and asymmetric cryptographic techniques, key establishment and management, device and user authentication, secure communication protocols (TLS, DTLS, CoAP, MQTT), identity management systems, role-based and attribute-based access control models, capability-based security mechanisms.

units.title: Network, Infrastructure and Privacy Security
units.topics: Security across IoT communication layers (physical, link, network, transport, application), secure M2M communication, intrusion detection and prevention in IoT networks, cloud and fog security, backend infrastructure security, secure data storage, secure resource management, database protection, privacy risks in IoT data collection, privacy-enhancing technologies (anonymization, pseudonymization, differential privacy), privacy-aware data aggregation, blockchain-based privacy approaches, trust models, policy-based trust management, consent frameworks.

units.title: Emerging Trends, Case Studies, and Regulations
units.topics: AI/ML-based intrusion detection in IoT, reinforcement learning for IoT security, edge and fog security models, zero-trust security architecture, IoT security testbeds and frameworks, smart home security, industrial IoT security, healthcare IoT security, IoT standards, regulatory policies, and legal compliance frameworks.

units.title: Blockchain Foundations & Cryptography
units.topics: Evolution of blockchain: Bitcoin to Web3, Blockchain architecture: Blocks, chains, nodes, P2P network, Permissioned vs. permissionless blockchains, Distributed Ledger Technologies (DLT), Cryptographic principles: Hashing, Merkle Trees, Digital Signatures, Zero-Knowledge Proofs (zkSNARKs, zkSTARKs), Consensus mechanisms: Proof of Work (PoW), Proof of Stake (POS), Delegated Proof of Stake (Dapos), Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PBFT), Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAG)

units.title: Smart Contracts & Decentralized Applications (Dapps)
units.topics: Smart contract fundamentals and design principles, Economic and legal aspects of smart contracts, Oracles and hybrid contracts: Conceptual overview, Security considerations: Common vulnerabilities, Mitigation strategies, Gas costs and optimization concepts.

units.title: Enterprise Blockchain Frameworks & Cross-Chain Interoperability
units.topics: Hyperledger Fabric, Corda, Quorum — architecture and use-cases, Cross-chain interoperability: Polka dot, Cosmos — concepts and industry relevance, Case studies and real-world examples.

units.title: Decentralized Finance (DeFi), NFTs & Regulations
units.topics: DeFi ecosystem, NFTs, DAOs, CBDCs — trends and conceptual frameworks, Regulatory frameworks: GDPR, KYC and AML, compliance challenges, Sustainability and green blockchain initiatives.

units.title: Advanced Trends-IoT, AI, Cloud Integration
units.topics: Blockchain for IoT: Secure device identity, data integrity, Blockchain for AI: Data provenance, AI model trustworthiness, Blockchain for Cloud: case study of Decentralized storage, edge computing integration, Privacy-enhancing techniques: Mixers, ring signatures, confidential transactions.

units.title: Understanding the Pillars of Intelligent Systems: AI, ML, and IoT
units.topics: IoT Fundamentals: Evolution, architecture (cloud, edge, fog), functional blocks (Sensors, Actuators) and communication Modules. AI & ML Fundamentals: Introduction to AI/ML concepts, programming languages (Python), algorithms, and frameworks

units.title: Data Processing and Analytics in the Internet of Things
units.topics: IOT Data Pre-processing: Data Preparation for Predictive Maintenance Modeling, Cleaning and Standardizing IoT Data, Applying Advanced Data Exploration Techniques Feature Engineering: Exploring Feature Engineering, Applying Feature Selection Techniques, Feature set selection using ML, Machine learning for Internet of Things data analysis

units.title: AI-Driven Methods for IoT
units.topics: Machine learning (ML) methods for IoT Applications: Decision Trees (DTs), Support Vector Machines (SVMs), Bayesian theorem-based algorithms, k-Nearest neighbor (KNN), Random Forest (RF), Association Rule (AR) algorithms, Ensemble learning (EL), k-Means clustering, Principal component analysis (PCA) Deep learning (DL) methods for IoT Applications: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs), Recurrent neural networks (RNNs), Deep autoencoders (AEs), Restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs), Deep belief networks (DBNs), Generative adversarial networks (GANs), Ensemble of DL networks (EDLNs)

units.title: AI Deployment in Edge and Cloud IoT Architectures
units.topics: Edge Computing on IOT Devices, IOT Based Smart Buildings, Distributed Machine Learning, Machine Learning Accelerator, Machine Learning Model Optimization, Least-Squares-Solver for Shallow Neural Network: Introduction, Algorithm Optimization, Hardware Implementation.

units.title: AI, ML and IoT: Applications and Case-Based Insights
units.topics: Applications of AI, ML and IOT, Case Studies: IOT for Agriculture, Remote Patient Monitoring, Smart City, Smart Transportation, IOT Security using ML

units.title: Overview of Wireless Sensor Networks for IoT
units.topics: Definition, features, and historical background of WSNs; Role of WSNs as the sensory backbone for IoT architectures; Node architecture: sensing, processing, communication, power subsystem; Node constraints: energy, computation, bandwidth, memory; Application domains: smart cities, environmental monitoring, industrial IoT (IIoT), healthcare.

units.title: Sensor Node and Network Architectures
units.topics: Hardware platforms (e.g., TelosB, MicaZ, ESP32, Raspberry Pi Pico); Operating systems for resource-constrained devices (Contiki, TinyOS, FreeRTOS); Network topologies: star, tree, mesh, clustered; Clustering schemes: LEACH, HEED, and their energy-efficient variants; Sink node placement, mobile sink concepts, and multi-sink deployment.

units.title: Communication and MAC Protocols
units.topics: Characteristics of wireless channels in sensor environments (path loss, fading, interference); MAC protocol design constraints in WSNs; Contention-based protocols (CSMA/CA, S-MAC, B-MAC); Schedule-based protocols (TDMA-based, TRAMA); Hybrid protocols (Z-MAC); IEEE 802.15.4 standard: architecture, PHY and MAC layer specifications, beacon-enabled vs non-beacon modes.

units.title: Routing, Addressing, and Synchronization
units.topics: Routing challenges in WSNs (energy, QoS, scalability); Data-centric routing (Flooding, Gossiping, SPIN, Directed Diffusion); Hierarchical routing (LEACH, PEGASIS); Location-based routing (GEAR, GPSR); 6LoWPAN: adaptation layer, header compression, fragmentation, mesh routing; RPL (Routing Protocol for Low-Power and Lossy Networks): DODAG construction, Objective Functions (OF0, MRHOF); Time synchronization in WSNs (TPSN, RBS) and Localization methods (range-based vs range-free).

units.title: Data Management, Reliability, and Integration with IoT Architectures
units.topics: Data aggregation, compression, and in-network processing techniques; Reliability and fault tolerance mechanisms at node and network levels; Edge, fog, and cloud integration architectures for WSNs; Security challenges: threats, lightweight cryptography, secure routing; Practical implementation: deployment of a mini-WSN using sensor nodes / simulation using tools like NS-3 / Cooja (Contiki).

units.title: INTRODUCTION TO INDUSTRIAL IoT
units.topics: Definition and Concept of IIoT: Evolution from IoT to IIoT, Key Differences between IoT and IIoT; Industry 4.0 and Smart Manufacturing: Vision, Principles, Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS); Architecture of IIoT: Sensing, Network, Edge, and Cloud Layers; Industrial Automation vs. IIoT: SCADA, DCS, PLC Integration with IIoT; Business Drivers, Benefits, and Economic Impact of IIoT Adoption.

units.title: IIOT COMMUNICATION, ADDRESSING AND NETWORKING
units.topics: Industrial Communication Protocols: Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP, CAN Bus, HART; Modern IoT Protocols in Industry: MQTT, CoAP, OPC UA (Open Platform Communications Unified Architecture); Wireless Technologies for Industry: WirelessHART, ISA100.11a, LoRaWAN, 5G for Industrial Automation; Addressing and Interoperability Challenges in Heterogeneous Industrial Networks; Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) and Deterministic Communication.

units.title: DATA ACQUISITION AND PROCESSING
units.topics: Sensors and Actuators in Industrial Environments: Temperature, Pressure, Vibration, Proximity, Flow; Edge Computing in IIoT: Role of Edge/Gateway Devices, Edge Analytics, Real-Time Processing; Industrial Gateways and Controllers: Embedded Linux, Industrial Raspberry Pi, Arduino for Automation; Big Data Analytics in Manufacturing: Predictive Maintenance, Fault Detection, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness); Cloud Platforms for IIoT: AWS IoT, Microsoft Azure IoT, Siemens MindSphere, PTC ThingWorx.

units.title: IIOT SECURITY AND STANDARDS
units.topics: Cybersecurity Threats in Industrial Environments: Vulnerabilities, Stuxnet, Ransomware, Attack Surfaces; Industrial Cybersecurity Standards: IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001; Secure Communication and Access Control: Encryption, PKI, Role-Based Access, Zero Trust Architecture; Safety and Reliability: Functional Safety (IEC 61508), Fail-Safe Designs, Redundancy; Ethical, Privacy, and Regulatory Considerations in Industrial Automation.

units.title: APPLICATIONS AND CASE STUDIES
units.topics: Smart Factory and Automation: Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), Robotics, Digital Twin; Energy and Utilities: Smart Grid, Water Treatment, Oil and Gas Sector Case Studies; Supply Chain and Logistics: Asset Tracking, Fleet Management, Cold Chain Monitoring; Healthcare and Process Industries: Pharma Automation, Cleanroom Monitoring; Hands-on Case Study/Mini-Project: Implementation of an IIoT pipeline (Sensor to Dashboard).

units.title: ARM, Raspberry Pi Microcontroller
units.topics: ARM Cortex-M: Architecture, Memory Organization, Exception Handling, Low-Power Modes. Peripheral Interfacing: GPIO, ADC, PWM, Timers, DMA with CMSIS / HAL. Raspberry Pi Microcontroller (RP2040): Architecture, Dual-Core Cortex-M0+, Memory Mapping, PIO (Programmable I/O) Subsystem, Development Tools (C/C++ SDK, MicroPython). Comparison between Cortex-M and RP2040 for Embedded/IoT applications.

units.title: Buses and Protocols
units.topics: Serial Communication Interfaces: UART, SPI, I2C, CAN: Framing, Timing, Multi-Master/Multi-Drop, Error Handling. USB: Device and Host Concepts, CDC and HID profiles. Wireless Protocols: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n), ZigBee, LoRa: Architecture, Framing, Integration with Microcontrollers. Hands-on Interfacing: Interfacing Sensors (I2C/SPI), Wireless Modules (BLE/Wi-Fi) with ARM/RP2040.

units.title: IoT Fundamentals
units.topics: IoT Architecture: Sensing Layer, Network Layer, Application Layer, Edge/Fog/Cloud Computing Concepts. IoT Communication Protocols: MQTT (Broker, Publish/Subscribe, QoS), CoAP, HTTP/REST, WebSockets. Data Formats and Serialization: JSON, XML, Protocol Buffers. Hands-on Implementation: Publishing Sensor Data to Local/Cloud MQTT Brokers (e.g., Mosquitto, ThingSpeak, AWS IoT).

units.title: Industrial IoT
units.topics: Industrial Embedded Platforms: Industrial Raspberry Pi (Revolution Pi, Kunbus, Compute Module), Ruggedized Systems. Industrial Protocols: Modbus (RTU/TCP), OPC UA: Architecture, Address Space, Security Model. Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN): Basics, Deterministic Ethernet in Automation. Hardware Security in IoT: Secure Boot, Hardware Cryptography (AES, SHA, TRNG), Secure Elements (e.g., ATECC608A).

units.title: IoT Applications
units.topics: Case Study 1: Smart Home Automation (Energy Management, Sensor Node Deployment using ARM + BLE/Wi-Fi). Case Study 2: Smart Agriculture (Soil Monitoring, Automated Irrigation using RP2040 + LoRa). Case Study 3: Industrial Asset Monitoring (Condition Monitoring, Predictive Maintenance using Vibration and Temperature Sensors with Modbus/OPC UA). Emerging Trends: Edge AI on Microcontrollers (TinyML), 5G Integration with IoT.

units.title: Java Programming Foundations for IoT Backends
units.topics: Java platform overview; JDK/JVM basics, memory model (stack/heap/GC overview), class loading (high level). Language essentials: variables, data types, operators, control statements (if/switch/loops). OOP fundamentals: classes, objects, constructors, method overloading/overriding, this, static. Interfaces & abstraction; basic packages/access modifiers; intro to collections & generics (list/map). Memory concepts: immutability basics, object lifetime, references vs values. Hands-on: Build a Java module for sensor reading validation & simple in-memory repository.

units.title: Node.js Fundamentals: Events, Buffers, Files, Timers
units.topics: Introduction to Node.js: runtime, npm, module system (Commons/ESM), blocking vs non-blocking I/O. Event Handling: Event loop, Event Emitter, custom events, callback vs Promise vs async/await. Buffer & String Handling: Buffer API, encoding (UTF-8/base64), binary vs text; working with streams. File Handling: fs (sync/async), streams (readable, writable, pipeline), directory ops, watchers. Timers: set Timeout, set Interval, set Immediate, scheduling caveats and drift. Hands-on: Build a Node service that ingests sample device files, parses buffers, raises events, and persists output.

units.title: Web Services: SOAP vs REST; Express.js Essentials
units.topics: Web Services landscape: SOAP fundamentals (WSDL, envelope), REST principles (resources, verbs, status codes). SOAP vs REST comparison: coupling, tooling, payload formats, typical IoT fit. Express.js: routing, middleware, query/path params, request validation, error handling. Designing REST APIs for IoT: Device registration (provisioning, keys/tokens), Device status & configuration endpoints, Telemetry ingestion (JSON), pagination & filtering, Versioning, idempotency, rate limiting (concepts). Serialization: JSON/CSV basics; brief on CBOR/Protobuf (awareness). Testing & Docs: Postman/Thunder Client, Open API (Swagger) annotations/tools.

units.title: Data Management, Visualization & Dashboard Design
units.topics: Data management: schema choices (events vs state), simple SQL/NoSQL options (awareness), indexing basics. Server-side data ops (Node/Java): validation, transformation, ETL mini-patterns. Data Visualization: principles (clarity, scales, aggregation), charts for telemetry (line, area, bar). Dashboard Design: layout, widgets, alerts, auto-refresh, access control basics. Basics of Angular 4: project structure (CLI), components, templates, data binding, services, HTTP client, routing. Integrating charts (e.g., Chart.js/Google Charts—concepts) and calling REST APIs.

units.title: Integration, Security Basics, and Performance
units.topics: Security basics for web/IoT: HTTPS/TLS (awareness), API keys/JWT (concepts), CORS, input validation, OWASP top-10 (intro). Logging & monitoring (concepts): structured logs, simple metrics; error handling strategies. Performance: async best practices, avoiding blocking calls, pagination, simple load testing (Postman/JMeter basics)

units.title: Introduction to Cyber Security
units.topics: Introduction to Cybersecurity, Basic Security Terminologies (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability), Types of Cyber Attacks (Phishing, Ransomware, Man-in-the-Middle, DDoS), Threat Landscape in Modern Digital Systems, Cybersecurity Frameworks, Cyber Laws and Compliance Basics.

units.title: Cryptographic Fundamentals for IoT Security Engineering
units.topics: Security Architecture of IoT Systems, Unique Vulnerabilities in IoT Devices (Resource Constraints, Weak Authentication, Physical Access), Attack Vectors across IoT Layers (Sensing, Network, Middleware, Application), IoT Threat Modeling (STRIDE, DREAD).

units.title: Identity and Access Management Solutions for the IoT
units.topics: Principles of Cryptography in IoT, Symmetric vs. Asymmetric Encryption, Lightweight Cryptography (e.g., PRESENT, SPECK), Hashing Algorithms (SHA-256) and Message Authentication Codes (MAC), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and Digital Certificates for IoT.

units.title: Attacks and Countermeasures
units.topics: Authentication Mechanisms for Constrained Devices, Access Control Models (RBAC, ABAC, Capability-Based Access Control), Key Management in Resource-Constrained Environments, Secure Device Provisioning and Onboarding, Trust Management and Identity Federations in IoT.

units.title: The IOT Security Lifecycle & Privacy Issue
units.topics: Common IoT Attacks (Botnets like Mirai, Replay Attacks, Sybil Attacks), Hardware Security (Physical Attacks, Side-Channel Analysis, Tamper-Resistance), Secure Boot and Firmware Updates (OTA), Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS) for IoT, Zero Trust Architecture for IoT Networks.

subjects.title: Energy and power management for IOT Devices

units.title: Introduction to IoT Energy & Power Requirements
units.topics: IoT device architecture, components, and application, Power consumption in IoT: active, idle, sleep modes Energy challenges in IoT networks. Metrics for energy efficiency (energy per operation, duty cycle, battery life) Case studies: power-hungry vs. low-power IoT devices

units.title: Power Sources for IoT Devices
units.topics: Primary & secondary batteries (Li-ion, NiMH, coin cells, thin-film batteries) , Battery performance parameters: lifetime, capacity, cycles. Supercapacitors & hybrid storage systems. Energy harvesting methods: Solar, Piezoelectric, Thermoelectric, RF harvesting. Comparative analysis of power sources for IoT

units.title: Low Power Design Techniques
units.topics: Hardware-level optimization: low-power MCUs, sensors, analog front-ends. Software-level techniques: duty cycling, DVFS, adaptive sensing. Power-aware communication protocols: Zigbee, BLE, Lora WAN, NB-IOT. Data transmission optimization: aggregation, compression, edge computing. Case study: Energy efficiency in wireless sensor networks (WSN)

units.title: Energy Management Systems for IoT
units.topics: Power Management ICs (PMICs), DC-DC converters, regulators. Energy-aware task scheduling & resource allocation. Sleep/wake-up strategies & synchronization in IoT nodes. Energy-aware routing protocols in IoT networks. Middleware and OS-level support (Tinos, Contiki, RIOT)

units.title: Future Trends and Applications
units.topics: AI/ML for energy optimization in IoT. Green IoT and sustainable energy models. Self-powered & battery-less IoT devices. Ultra-low-power wide-area networks (LPWAN). Real-world case studies: smart homes, healthcare, agriculture, industry.

units.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
units.topics: Introduction, Definition and motivation, History and evolution of Machine learning, types: Supervised, Unsupervised, Semi-supervised, Reinforcement, Machine Learning Models: Geometric, Probabilistic, Logical, and Parametric. Non-parametric, Applications of Machine Learning in Signal processing, speech recognition, image processing, Wireless communications.

units.title: Supervised Machine Learning
units.topics: Introduction to Supervised Learning, Types of Supervised Problems, Regression Models: Linear Regression, Types of Linear Regression, cost function, gradient descent of linear regression, Evaluation Metrics for Linear Regression. Classification Models: Logistic Naive Bayes algorithm KNN algorithm Support Vector Machine (SVM).

units.title: Unsupervised Machine Learning

units.title: Feature Engineering
units.topics: Importance of feature engineering in Machine Learning pipeline, handling missing values, outliers, encoding: Label, One-Hot, Ordinal, Target Scaling: Min-Max, Standardization, Normalization, Feature selection: Filter (Chi-square), Wrapper (RFE), Embedded (Lasso)

units.title: Ensemble Learning and Model Evaluation
units.topics: Introduction to Ensembles, Need of Ensemble Learning, Basic Ensemble Learning Techniques: Voting (Hard/Soft), Advanced Ensemble Learning Techniques: Bagging (Random Forest), Boosting (AdaBoost, XGBoost), Stacking, Cross-validation: Hold-out, K-Fold, LOOCV, Model comparison using t-test, McNemar’s test, Hyperparameter tuning (Grid Search, Random Search)

units.title: Introduction to Edge and Fog Computing (EFC)
units.topics: Historical Background, Characteristics, Definitions and Use Cases of Edge and Fog Computing (EFC), Drivers for Edge/Fog Computing (Latency, Bandwidth, Privacy, Autonomy), Differences between Cloud, Fog, and Edge Computing, Edge Computing and Edge-to-Cloud Continuum, Edge Hardware Platforms (SBCs, Embedded Devices, Edge Servers, FPGAs/TPUs), Fog/Edge Architectures: OpenFog Consortium Reference Architecture, ETSI MEC (Multi-Access Edge Computing).

units.title: Protocols and communication models in EFC
units.topics: EFC Communication Protocols: MQTT, CoAP, AMQP, DDS, ZeroMQ, Protocols for Edge-to-Cloud Integration: HTTP/REST, WebSockets, gRPC, Edge-to-Edge and Edge-to-Fog Communication Strategies, Wireless and Cellular Communication for EFC (5G, Wi-Fi 6, LoRaWAN), Data Serialization Formats: JSON, Protocol Buffers, MessagePack.

units.title: IoT Architectures and its integration with EFC
units.topics: Role of Edge/Fog Computing in IoT, Architectures: Gateway-Based, Hierarchical, Distributed, Microservices and Containerization at the Edge (Docker, Containerd), Edge Orchestration Platforms: K3s, MicroK8s, EdgeX Foundry, Baetyl, KubeEdge, Data Ingestion, Local Processing, and Filtering at the Edge, Edge-to-Cloud Synchronization, Hybrid Cloud-Edge Solutions.

units.title: Evolution and Convergence of 5G and IoT
units.topics: Overview of Cellular Technologies: From 4G/LTE to 5G, Drivers for 5G-IoT Convergence, Key Capabilities of 5G: eMBB (Enhanced Mobile Broadband), URLLC (Ultra-Reliable Low-Latency Communication), mMTC (massive Machine Type Communication), Spectrum for 5G-IoT: Sub-6 GHz and mmWave Bands, Private 5G Networks for IoT, IoT Constraints vs. 5G Performance Metrics (Latency, Throughput, Scalability, Energy Efficiency).

units.title: 5G Network Architecture and Enablers for IoT
